name: LULA reward recycle confiscates and re-syncs the LULA/USDT pair reserve
summary: LULA.recycle() lets the rental contract move up to a third of the LULA/USDT pair's LULA to itself and sync() the pair, and the rental's claimTeamReward() calls it on every payout. The attacker bought the pair's LULA float into a fee-exempt address with flash-loaned USDT, ran 41 claims that took the pair's remaining LULA, and sold it back for the USDT.
notes: LULA's reset is initialize(), which set rentalContract (slot 0xc), the only caller recycle() accepts; it came after both deployments. The rental contract is unverified; its claimTeamReward()->recycle() path is read from the exploit trace.

Net USDT depletion of the LULA/USDT pair, the only victim; no other transaction drained it. The 7,997,208.89 LULA the pair also lost is not valued: the pair was left with 181.58 USDT against 4,749 LULA.
